잠언-31-1.title: 잠언 31장 1절 역사문법적 주해
잠언-31-1.exegesis: 33. That is, strife-- or other ills, as surely arise from devising evil as natural effects from natural causes.

잠언-31-3.title: 잠언 31장 3절 역사문법적 주해
잠언-31-3.exegesis: 2. What, my son?-- that is, What shall I say? Repetitions denote earnestness. son of my womb-- as our phrase, "my own son," a term of special affection. son of my vows-- as one dedicated to God; so the word "Lemuel" may mean.

잠언-31-4.title: 잠언 31장 4절 역사문법적 주해
잠언-31-4.exegesis: 3-9. Succinct but solemn warnings against vices to which kings are peculiarly tempted, as carnal pleasures and oppressive and unrighteous government are used to sustain sensual indulgence. strength-- mental and bodily resources for health and comfort. thy ways-- or course of life. to that ... kings-- literally, "to the destroying of kings," avoid destructive pleasures (compare Pr 5:9 ; 7:22 , 27 ; Ho 4:11 ).
잠언-31-4.theologicalNote: 3-9. 잠언-31-11.title: 잠언 31장 11절 역사문법적 주해
잠언-31-11.exegesis: 10-31. This exquisite picture of a truly lovely wife is conceived and drawn in accordance with the customs of Eastern nations, but its moral teachings suit all climes. In Hebrew the verses begin with the letters of the Hebrew alphabet in order (compare Introduction to Poetical Books). Who ... woman-- The question implies that such are rare, though not entirely wanting (compare Pr 18:22 ; 19:14 ). virtuous-- literally, "of strength," that is, moral courage (compare Pr 12:4 ; Ru 3:11 ). her price, &c.-- (compare Pr 3:15 ).
